scenario: The ego vehicle merges onto a main highway from an on-ramp while an adversarial vehicle travels straight in the adjacent lane.

ego.behavior: The car accelerates along the on-ramp and merges left into the main highway lane.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward in the main highway lane at a constant speed.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle starts on a curved on-ramp that joins a multi-lane highway from the right, while the adversarial vehicle is positioned ahead in the main highway lane parallel to the ego's merge path.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must merge safely into traffic without collision; the scenario terminates once the ego has fully established itself in the main highway lane.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned alongside the main highway near the merge point.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the car on the on-ramp; the adversarial is the car already on the highway. 2. Chronology: initially ego is behind on the ramp; midpoint ego accelerates and begins merging; ending ego completes merge into highway lane. 3. Evidence: ego's lateral position shifts from ramp to main lane; adversarial maintains constant forward trajectory in the main lane throughout all frames.
